about.description: I'm a Full Stack & AI Engineer who builds practical, production-ready software. My focus is on agentic AI systems using LangGraph, LangChain, and RAG pipelines, alongside a solid MERN/Next.js foundation. With 1+ year of professional experience, I've shipped web applications across healthcare, retail, and business domains. My MCA capstone project, DocuMind, is a 6-agent LangGraph platform for multilingual legal document intelligence — achieving an 87.5% latency reduction through targeted optimizations.
highlights: Multi-Agent AI Systems with LangGraph & LangChain
Full-Stack Delivery with FastAPI, Next.js & MERN

experience.description: Engineered a scalable EMR web application (Robosensy) using the MERN stack, improving API response time by 30% through query optimization and efficient schema design. Automated a legacy MongoDB database migration using Python scripts, restructuring data across 10+ collections to align with updated schemas. Built and deployed a cross-platform Gym Management system (Web + React Native), and managed deployments on AWS EC2 with Docker and CI/CD pipelines.
Improved UI/UX for key modules, reducing page load time by 25%. Increased user engagement by 20%. Collaborated with design and backend teams to accelerate delivery by 15%.

projects.name: DocuMind
projects.description: A multi-agent document intelligence platform built with LangGraph — featuring 6 specialized agents (extraction, classification, summarization, risk, QA, routing) for automated processing of Hindi/English/Hinglish legal documents. Built a hybrid RAG pipeline (ChromaDB + BM25 + RRF) achieving ~85% retrieval accuracy on 50+ page multilingual legal corpora. Optimized latency from 56s to ~7s by bypassing LLM tool-calling serialization bottlenecks using Groq json_mode and implementing _chain_cache (speeding up RAG QA retrieval from 10s to 0.88s). Deployed with Docker on AWS EC2 with LangSmith tracing. Built as MCA capstone project.

projects.name: PropConnect AI
projects.tagline: Multi-Tenant Real Estate SaaS with AI Chatbot
projects.description: A production-grade multi-tenant real estate SaaS built solo, centered around an AI chatbot core that replaces predefined flows with a true LLM agent. Built with LangGraph orchestrating multi-turn conversation state, LangChain, and FastAPI, the assistant understands natural language, maintains context, collects buyer preferences (property type, budget, location, bedrooms), and invokes backend tools to search a 2,000+ listing catalog via structured SQL over PostgreSQL. Covers lead management/CRM with WhatsApp and call-reminder workflows, multi-agent/multi-branch property listing management, and human-in-the-loop site-visit scheduling (chatbot captures request → admin approves → customer confirmation). Deployed with Docker on AWS EC2, media assets on AWS S3.

projects.name: ResearchPilot
